name: Vanuatu
famous_for: Mount Yasur accessible bubbling active volcano on Tanna, ancient land diving (ancestor of bungee jumping), and crystal blue holes of Espiritu Santo.
tourists: Over 120,000 visitors; famous for Mount Yasur volcano crater edge walks, Champagne Beach, and Million Dollar Point dive.
must_know: The land diving ritual (Naghol) on Pentecost Island inspired modern bungee jumping: men leap from 30-meter wooden towers with only vines tied to ankles.
fun_fact: Mount Yasur on Tanna island has been erupting continuously for over 800 years, dubbed the 'Lighthouse of the Pacific' by Captain Cook.
